title: Experiment config schema + server-side validation (routes, variants, allocation, eligibility) + migration plan
creator: Ethan Park
dependencies: ENG-9023 experiment assignment cache and propagation
description:
Implement the experiment configuration model (schema) for route-level A/B testing and enforce server-side validation. Include an explicit migration/versioning strategy so we can evolve the schema during beta without breaking existing experiments/config propagation.

This ticket covers control-plane schema + validation only (storage model + API payload shape + errors). Routing evaluation, attribution/telemetry, and Console UI are handled in separate tickets.

Primary stakeholders: Ethan Park (Control plane), Jordan Lee (assignment constraints), Marissa Cole / Dylan Brooks (Console requirements), Sean Gallagher (SRE guardrails on safety).
acceptance_criteria:
- A canonical ExperimentConfig schema exists (CRD or equivalent internal config model) and is used by the experiment service + Console APIs.
- Server-side validation rejects invalid configs with actionable error messages (field path + reason + suggested fix when possible).
- Validation covers: route references + eligibility rules; variant definitions; allocation constraints; and basic safety checks (limits / overlap rules / compatibility checks).
- Schema includes a version field and a migration plan to support additive changes during beta (including backfill/migration hooks for persisted configs).
- Unit tests cover common failure cases + edge cases from the validation working doc.
- Documentation note added to internal HOWTO/runbooks on how validation failures surface in Console/API.
body:
Context
- We are adding route-level experiments (A/B/n) at the routing layer. The control plane needs a durable, validated config representation that the policy engine can evaluate deterministically.
- This ticket is the “source of truth” for what an experiment config is and what is rejected.

Proposed schema (v1alpha)
(Exact field names per implementation in PR-28411; summary below is for review/requirements alignment.)

Top-level
- experiment_id: immutable identifier
- name: human-readable
- description: optional
- state: Draft | Running | Stopping | Stopped (state machine handled in Console API ticket; schema must support it)
- created_at/created_by, updated_at/updated_by (audit events elsewhere, but config should record actor metadata where feasible)
- config_version: monotonic integer OR semver-ish string (see Migration/Versioning)

Targeting
- routes: list of route selectors (route_id(s) or route patterns normalized by route registry)
- eligibility: rules evaluated before assignment (e.g., customer/account allowlist, region allowlist/denylist, request attributes)
  - NOTE: keep eligibility simple for beta to avoid a second policy language; prefer referencing existing policy predicates.

Bucketing / stickiness inputs (constraints from ADR-047)
- stickiness_key: enum/ordered preference list (e.g., explicit customer-provided key header, then customer_id, then request_id fallback)
- salt: stable salt per experiment for hash input

Variants
- variants: list
  - variant_id: stable identifier (used for attribution)
  - display_name
  - route_override / policy_override: what changes for this variant (e.g., model_id override, quantization profile, region preference)
  - compatibility constraints: optional (e.g., endpoint type: chat vs embeddings; model supports tools/JSON schema)

Allocation
- allocation: mapping variant_id -> weight
- allocation_mode: fixed (v1); future: ramp schedule (out of scope)

Validation rules (server-side)
Hard rejects
- Required fields present: experiment_id, routes, variants (>=2), allocation
- Unique IDs: variant_id uniqueness; route selectors no duplicates after normalization
- Allocation:
  - all variants referenced in allocation exist
  - weights are numeric and non-negative
  - sum(weights) == 1.0 (tolerance: 1e-6) OR == 100 depending on representation; choose one and standardize error messages
  - no “zero-traffic variant” unless explicitly allowed (we decided: reject weights == 0 in beta to prevent accidental dead variants; follow-up if needed)
- Limits:
  - max variants: 5 (beta safety + metrics cardinality control)
  - max routes per experiment: 20 (guardrail for blast radius; aligns with Console copy)
- Eligibility:
  - referenced attributes/predicates must exist in policy engine
  - region identifiers must match known region set
- Route overlap / safety:
  - block overlapping Running experiments on the same route by default
  - allow overlap only if one is Draft/Stopped OR if an explicit “priority” field is set (not planned for beta). For beta: reject overlaps and provide error listing the conflicting experiment_id(s).

Soft warnings (accepted but recorded)
- Missing high-entropy stickiness key configuration: if stickiness_key would fall back to a low-entropy identifier, record a warning and surface via Console banner (actual surface area handled in Console ticket; this ticket just returns warnings in API response where possible).

Error message guidelines
- Validation errors should include:
  - field path (e.g., variants[1].variant_id)
  - machine code (e.g., ALLOCATION_SUM_INVALID)
  - human message
  - hint/suggested fix (when safe)

Migration / versioning plan
Goal: allow additive schema changes during beta and safe upgrades of stored configs.
- Add explicit config_version to persisted config records.
- Provide a migration function chain on read (N -> latest) with:
  - deterministic transforms
  - unit tests per migration
  - logging/metrics on migration usage (to know when old versions persist)
- For Phase 1, ship v1alpha + placeholder migration harness even if no migrations exist yet.
- Anticipated migrations during beta:
  - stickiness_key precedence tweaks / defaulting behavior
  - eligibility rule syntax adjustments
  - addition of ‘audit’ metadata fields / optional limits
- Coordinate with ENG-9023 (propagation) to ensure caches key by (experiment_id, config_version) to avoid stale reads.

Testing
- Unit tests for:
  - allocation sum mismatch
  - duplicate variant_id
  - allocation references unknown variant
  - >5 variants
  - overlapping experiments on same route
  - invalid region in eligibility
  - invalid route selector / unknown route_id
- Property-ish test (lightweight): random allocations normalized to sum 1 pass; random invalid weights fail.

Open questions resolved in ticket
- Allocation representation: standardize on weights summing to 1.0 (float) in API payload; storage uses integer basis points to avoid floating drift. (If implementation differs, update docs/tests accordingly.)
- Overlapping experiments: reject for beta (no priority semantics yet).

Rollout considerations
- This schema is a prerequisite for Console experiment creation wizard; expect early iteration with Design/PM on error copy.
- Keep backward-compatible additions only until GA; any breaking change requires a migration + staged rollout.

Links
- ADR-047: Deterministic experiment bucketing (hash inputs + stickiness precedence)
- Drive: experiment-config-validation-edge-cases (working list of edge cases)
- PR-28411 implements initial CRD + validation

Done criteria / what shipped
- PR-28411 merged: config schema + validation + unit tests + error codes
- Follow-up PR-28692 merged: config versioning + migration harness (added during beta hardening; referenced here for completeness)

Follow-ups (not in scope here)
- Console: user-friendly surfacing of warnings vs errors (ENG-9024/9025)
- Policy engine: ensure evaluator consumes same normalized route identifiers (ENG-9022)
- Audit: ensure validation errors are included in audit event payloads when a mutation fails (ENG-9030)
comments: 2025-01-14 (Ethan Park): Creating ticket as Phase 1 blocker. Need a single canonical schema so policy engine + Console + telemetry agree on dimensions/IDs. Please keep validation strict; we’ve been burned by silent defaults in rollouts.

2025-01-16 (Jordan Lee): From ADR-047: please ensure schema can represent stickiness precedence (explicit key header > customer_id > request_id). Also strongly recommend rejecting missing/low-entropy defaults; we saw skew in an earlier prototype.
2025-01-22 (Marissa Cole): Console creation flow needs field-level errors. Please return structured errors (path + code + message). Also we should cap variants at 5 for GA to keep UX legible.

2025-01-27 (Sean Gallagher): SRE ask: block overlapping experiments on the same route for beta. Otherwise blast radius becomes ambiguous during incident response. If we later add priority, it must be visible in UI + alerts.

2025-02-03 (Benji Okafor): Implemented v1alpha schema + validation in PR-28411. Added basis-points conversion internally to avoid float drift; API accepts weights and normalizes. Added explicit error codes + field paths.

2025-02-07 (Chloe Martin): Reviewed API error payload shape; looks good for Console mapping. Request: include conflicting experiment_ids when overlap validation triggers so UI can link to the conflicting experiment.
2025-02-11 (Benji Okafor): Added overlap error details + tests. Also added warnings list in response for low-entropy stickiness scenarios (non-blocking).

2025-02-18 (Michael Nguyen): For migrations/versioning: recommend explicit config_version + migrate-on-read harness; will be needed once beta customers have persisted Draft configs. I’ll take follow-up PR but linking here.
2025-02-21 (Ethan Park): Marking Done. Schema + validation merged and unblocked policy evaluator + Console API work. Migration harness tracked in PR-28692 and referenced in GA checklist.
